title: 2026 Topps Series 1 Baseball Rookie Card Lot 10 Otto Kemp Ryan Ritter Fuentes RC
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Lots
descriptionText:
2026 Topps Series 1 Baseball - 10 Card Rookie Lot (Topps 75th Anniversary)

You will receive the exact 10 rookie base cards shown in the photos:

Otto Kemp #187 - Philadelphia Phillies (RC)
Jeremiah Jackson #277 - Baltimore Orioles (RC)
Brandyn Garcia #163 - Arizona Diamondbacks (RC)
Lazaro Estrada #299 - Toronto Blue Jays (RC)
Ryan Ritter #18 - Colorado Rockies (RC)
Travis Adams #149 - Minnesota Twins (RC)
Didier Fuentes #243 - Atlanta Braves (RC)
Nathan Church #24 - St. Louis Cardinals (RC)
Pierson Ohl #321 - Minnesota Twins (RC)
Carson Seymour #112 - San Francisco Giants (RC)

All cards are ungraded and in the condition shown in the photos. Please review all pictures carefully, as they are of the actual cards you will receive.

Cards ship in penny sleeves and a top loader inside a bubble mailer for protection. Thanks for looking!
